testCase.name: [dev] S09 Complete and Delete are separate taps and separate events on every task surface, including the Tasks overlay, in both modes

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S09 「Complete 和 Delete 在每个任务界面上（包括 Tasks 浮层）都是分开的点击、分开的事件，两种模式」 Complete and Delete are separate taps and separate events on every task surface, including the Tasks overlay, in both modes

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 Completing a task and deleting a task are separate actions, and each is logged as its own analytics event (task completed / task deleted), one per tap, against the chart.（UAT TC-24；UAT OAT-06 item 7；TFA-94514 AC 2）
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Hospital patient with five open tasks; Nursing Home resident with two open tasks

When Hospital Encounter tab: Complete 'Recheck BMP in AM', Delete 'PT eval before discharge'. Hospital Post-Round: Complete 'Order echo', Delete 'Call case management'. Account-wide Tasks overlay from the Hospital list: Complete 'Check telemetry'. …

Then Completed tasks show as done (not deleted); deleted tasks are gone. Exactly three task-completed events (one from the overlay) and two task-deleted events against the Hospital chart, and one of each against the resident, none carrying task text; the day rollup's tasksCompleted / tasksDeleted match.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT TC-24 bullet 4 + OAT-06 item 7 + TFA-94514 AC 2. UI checkpoints via oracle.mjs; event counts by a post-run backend read of pilotUsageEvents (event, patientId, careSetting) and pilotDailyRounding for the run account, exact counts per chart and event. The overlay Complete must add exactly one task_completed for that chart. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S09 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-24.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
